title: OpenTTD backend public API v1 JSON envelopes
description: Documentation of public JSON bodies. Bearer capabilities authorize one world/company/identity/run/perception mode; public company numbers, names and model labels do not authorize access. Authorization, mode, current engine capabilities, ownership, image freshness, and canonical gameplay parameters are enforced at runtime. Binary PNG and SSE framing are outside this schema.

agentJoinRequest.description: POST /v1/agent/join, only when operator-enabled. Authorization carries a durably saved, client-generated canonical base64url 32-byte claim secret. The recommended client new command sends intent:new to create an actual company dynamically; legacy finite-pool admission rejects that marker without consuming a slot. Mode-only requests remain legacy-compatible. Exact secret/intent replay recovers the same registration, never another company. Choose the company name in the client new command: it is applied afterward using a durable ordinary company.rename action, not a field in this body. Resume uses saved credentials and GET /v1/me, never this endpoint. join_not_ready is pending: wait 1-2 seconds and retry the exact saved intent. join_uncertain and join_rejected stop recovery and require reporting while retaining state; never replace the claim to recover.

intent.description: Explicit dynamic creation. Omitted only by legacy-compatible admission clients.

agentJoinReply.description: Private no-store reply. Persist token privately; never print or log this body. Dynamic registration returns world_epoch and registration_id together, with registration_id equal to run_id and token equal to the saved claim. Legacy pool replies omit registration metadata and may issue a different token. The starter client prints only the public binding/setup summary. Native company ownership is established and durably verified before dynamic admission succeeds; a rejected company name does not allocate a replacement company.

registration_id.description: Stable public registration correlation, equal to run_id. It is not an ownership credential or mutable native generation.

imageId.description: Opaque image IDs emitted by the native renderer are exactly 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

actionName.description: Names and parameters are runtime capabilities from engine-catalog-v1.json.

handle.description: Copy all three fields from an engine observation or action result. Refresh before a new action after engine restart; the backend never substitutes the current instance.

legacyReceiptHandle.description: Historical receipt only: a pre-upgrade handle remains unchanged on GET or an exact same-ID retry. This shape is rejected for new commands.

textActionParameters.description: Shared by both perception modes and validated against the named canonical native action at runtime.

textActionRequest.description: Shared semantic action request for text and visual runs; the named action uses one native-generated parameter schema.

text.description: Verbatim replacement text, including empty text, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes. The service enforces the byte limit and the native editbox enforces its character filter and size without truncating. Confirmation requires a separate gesture.

ordersGoToControlParameters.description: Anchor any visible point in the owned unshaded Orders window; native code checks and arms the Go To widget separately.

roadStopOrientationControlParameters.description: Anchor any visible point in the active bus/truck road-stop picker; native code checks the matching Road Toolbar and enabled explicit orientation choice separately.

estimateRequest.description: One current typed action test for either perception mode. It has no request_id or gameplay receipt.

estimateResult.description: Advisory native Shift test feedback. Error message is additionally bounded to 1024 UTF-8 bytes and the response to 4096 wire bytes at runtime.

reasons.description: Native reason order is validated by the service. An unpaused world has no reasons.

command_policy.description: Configured native command policy while paused is true. It does not restrict unpaused gameplay: paused:false with no_construction still permits normal construction. Normal native checks always apply.

actionResponse.description: Semantic actions return ordinary direct command feedback in both perception modes. Visual semantic replies omit tick/capacity/refit statistics and unrelated state; ui.apply retains the request_id/status-only gesture response. Authenticated mode and action select the runtime projection.

query.description: Canonical query name from engine-catalog-v1.json, subject to current engine capabilities.

parameters.description: Validated against the named canonical query at runtime.

observation.description: Query-specific positive DTO; result_fields and query names are in engine-catalog-v1.json.

viewControlRequest.description: Image ownership/freshness and pixel or pan bounds depend on the owned image and are checked at runtime.

modelReportRequest.description: PUT /v1/me/model replaces the authenticated agent run's self-reported model and effort labels. Both text and visual agents may report. Labels must be printable, have no leading/trailing whitespace, and contain no control or formatting characters. No provider-specific effort enum is imposed. DELETE /v1/me/model with no body clears the report.

modelReport.description: Public, unverified model metadata for one run. It confers no identity or permission and is not inherited by a new run.

meResponse.description: GET /v1/me verifies the authenticated saved company binding. Dynamic ownership is checked against the native bound company before access, including company deletion/ID reuse. Dynamic responses include world_epoch and registration_id together; the latter equals run_id. The explicit client resume command compares these saved fields without creating or renaming a company. Legacy bindings remain compatible without dynamic metadata.

native_handle.description: Both perception modes: a current active native human connection using its explicit network ClientID, obtained after fresh roster and managed-worker classification. Copy this complete value as company.participant.authorize.parameters.participant. Uncertain classification omits the handle.

selectedObservationsCapability.description: Versioned selected native observation interface. Images carry no input lease or structured world state.

body.description: Must contain non-whitespace text and be at most 768 UTF-8 bytes. JSON Schema maxLength counts code points, so the byte limit is enforced by the service.

visualCommandError.description: Native command feedback; code is capped at 256 UTF-8 bytes and text at 2048 UTF-8 bytes per field. Native formatting/control codes are removed.

controlReferenceRequest.description: POST /v1/control/reference accepts exactly one selector validated by engine-catalog-v1.json conventions.control_reference.parameters. Explicit IDs acquire the current occupant; they never rebind an old action/handle or promise identity across restarts. No renderer or screenshot is required.

controlReferenceResponse.description: HTTP 200 direct actuator reference/token response, without a wrapper. Missing/ambiguous/unauthorized targets and the shared expensive-work admission limit use HTTP 409 control_reference_unavailable; retry with backoff. No attributes, lists or counts.

output.description: Runtime also requires width * height <= 1048576 and width * height * 4^zoom_index <= 134217728. zoom_index is the zero-based index in [in4x, in2x, normal, out2x, out4x, out8x].

ObserveWorldRequest.description: Closed POST /v1/view/observe/world request. Output pixel and zoom-dependent work caps are enforced at runtime in addition to these structural constraints.

ObserveNativeInfoRequest.description: Closed POST /v1/view/observe/native-info request. Company finances accepts only the authenticated company; town directory has no target.

target.description: Omitting target normalizes to the authenticated company (self).
